name: ViTMatte (base)
purpose: Hair and fine edges of Subject, Background and People masks.

data: Composition-1k (from Adobe's Deep Image Matting dataset, distributed on request for research)

notes: Converted by research/prototypes/masking/convert_vitmatte.py (ViTMatte-base, fixed 1024x1024 tiles; the backbone's position embeddings frozen for that size) and compress_vitmatte.py (8-bit weights in blocks of 32; within 0.002 of fp16 on average over a portrait tile's unsure pixels). On hair_bench's heads, over a band from 1% of the long side inside the coarse edge to 5% outside, it halves closed-form matting's error along the edge and keeps 43% of the strands against 15% (vitmatte_bench.py). 0.2 s a tile on an M1 Ultra's GPU; the Neural Engine is slower. Its training data allows research use only; the owner accepted it for everyone as an exception (DEC-35). Published, with the owner's approval (DEC-26), as the prerelease models-vitmatte-base-v1, with its licence (LICENSE.txt). Not cleared for everyone: on the evaluation set's photos it pulls background beside the subject into the matte (dark, flat or foliage backgrounds), which closed-form matting leaves out (vitmatte_bench.py eval).
